about: Plain-language descriptions of common generic (SAE J2012) trouble codes and failure types, written for CANary. Codes whose meaning the car maker defines (P1xxx, most B, C and U codes) are described by their system only.

codes.P0011: Intake camshaft timing over-advanced or slow to respond (bank 1)
codes.P0014: Exhaust camshaft timing over-advanced or slow to respond (bank 1)
codes.P0016: Crankshaft and camshaft positions do not agree (bank 1, intake). Often a stretched timing chain
codes.P0017: Crankshaft and camshaft positions do not agree (bank 1, exhaust)
codes.P0018: Crankshaft and camshaft positions do not agree (bank 2, intake)
codes.P0019: Crankshaft and camshaft positions do not agree (bank 2, exhaust)
codes.P0030: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0031: Oxygen sensor heater circuit low (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0032: Oxygen sensor heater circuit high (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0036: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit (bank 1, sensor 2)
codes.P0034: Turbocharger bypass (diverter) valve control circuit low
codes.P0035: Turbocharger bypass (diverter) valve control circuit high
codes.P0045: Turbocharger boost control solenoid circuit open
codes.P0046: Turbocharger boost control solenoid range or performance
codes.P0068: Manifold pressure, air flow and throttle position do not agree
codes.P0101: Mass air flow sensor range or performance
codes.P0102: Mass air flow sensor circuit low
codes.P0103: Mass air flow sensor circuit high
codes.P0106: Manifold pressure sensor range or performance
codes.P0111: Intake air temperature sensor range or performance
codes.P0112: Intake air temperature sensor circuit low
codes.P0113: Intake air temperature sensor circuit high
codes.P0116: Coolant temperature sensor range or performance
codes.P0121: Throttle position sensor range or performance
codes.P0125: Engine too cold for closed-loop fuel control
codes.P0128: Coolant temperature below thermostat regulating temperature. Usually a thermostat stuck open
codes.P0134: Oxygen sensor shows no activity (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0140: Oxygen sensor shows no activity (bank 1, sensor 2)
codes.P0171: Mixture too lean (bank 1). Unmetered air or low fuel delivery
codes.P0174: Mixture too lean (bank 2). Unmetered air or low fuel delivery
codes.P0191: Fuel rail pressure sensor range or performance
codes.P0192: Fuel rail pressure sensor circuit low
codes.P0193: Fuel rail pressure sensor circuit high
codes.P0196: Engine oil temperature sensor range or performance
codes.P0221: Throttle position sensor B range or performance
codes.P0222: Throttle position sensor B circuit low
codes.P0223: Throttle position sensor B circuit high
codes.P0236: Boost pressure sensor range or performance
codes.P0299: Turbocharger underboost: boost pressure well below target
codes.P0313: Misfire detected with low fuel level
codes.P0321: Engine speed sensor range or performance
codes.P0336: Crankshaft position sensor range or performance
codes.P0341: Camshaft position sensor range or performance (bank 1)
codes.P0366: Camshaft position sensor B range or performance (bank 1)
codes.P0441: Evaporative emission system: incorrect purge flow
codes.P0451: Fuel tank pressure sensor range or performance
codes.P0455: Evaporative emission system: large leak. Check the fuel cap first
codes.P0456: Evaporative emission system: very small leak
codes.P0457: Evaporative emission system leak: fuel cap loose or off
codes.P0461: Fuel level sensor range or performance
codes.P0501: Vehicle speed sensor range or performance
codes.P0507: Idle speed higher than expected. Often an intake leak
codes.P0520: Oil pressure sensor or switch circuit
codes.P0521: Oil pressure sensor range or performance
codes.P0532: Air-conditioning refrigerant pressure sensor circuit low
codes.P0544: Exhaust gas temperature sensor circuit (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0641: Sensor reference voltage A circuit open
codes.P0651: Sensor reference voltage B circuit open
codes.P0700: Transmission control system has a fault stored
codes.P0711: Transmission fluid temperature sensor range or performance
codes.P0741: Torque converter clutch stuck off or slipping
codes.P0841: Transmission fluid pressure sensor A range or performance
codes.P2004: Intake manifold runner control stuck open (bank 1)
codes.P2006: Intake manifold runner control stuck closed (bank 1)
codes.P2015: Intake manifold runner position sensor range or performance (bank 1)
codes.P2101: Throttle actuator motor range or performance
codes.P2135: Throttle position sensors A and B do not agree
codes.P2138: Accelerator pedal sensors D and E do not agree
codes.P2187: Mixture too lean at idle (bank 1). Usually unmetered air
codes.P2262: Turbocharger boost pressure not detected: mechanical fault
codes.P2563: Turbocharger boost control position sensor range or performance
codes.P261A: Coolant pump B control circuit open
codes.U0100: Lost communication with the engine control module
codes.U0101: Lost communication with the transmission control module
codes.U0121: Lost communication with the ABS control module
codes.U0140: Lost communication with the body control module
codes.U0155: Lost communication with the instrument cluster
codes.U0401: Invalid data received from the engine control module
codes.U1113: Function limited because of a fault in another control unit

patterns.text: Ignition coil primary or secondary circuit

ranges.text: Fuel and air metering or auxiliary emission control
Fuel and air metering: injector or boost circuit
Vehicle speed, idle control or auxiliary inputs
Powertrain (fuel, air, ignition or emission control)

failure_types.04: internal failure of the control unit
failure_types.14: circuit shorted to ground or open
failure_types.15: circuit shorted to battery voltage or open
